Meaning: common present plural or honorific form of होना; are

Meaning: who; which; that in a relative clause

Meaning: masculine singular past form of होना; was

Meaning: then; so; contrast or emphasis particle

Example: मुझे घर साफ़ करने में मदद चाहिए।

Notes: Used before postpositions and in several infinitive constructions.

Meaning: went; masculine singular completed form of जाना

Notes: Also serves as an auxiliary in passive and completion constructions.

Notes: A very common motion verb and auxiliary.

Meaning: goes; habitual masculine form of जाना
Example Meaning: He goes to school every day.
Notes: Agrees here with a masculine singular subject.

Example: मुझे यह किताब वापस देना है।
Example Pronunciation: mujhe yeh kitāb vāpas denā hai.
Example Meaning: I have to return this book.
Notes: Also combines with another verb to add a sense of doing something for or away from oneself.

Meaning: gave; masculine completed form of देना
Example Meaning: She gave me the correct address.
Notes: Agreement follows normal perfective transitive patterns.

Example Meaning: I need to buy a ticket.
Notes: The sense “buy” is common when the object is something purchased.

Meaning: took; bought; masculine completed form of लेना
Example Meaning: I bought a new phone today.
Notes: Context distinguishes taking from buying.

Example Meaning: I have something to tell you.
Notes: Normal pronunciation is kahnā, with no extra vowel after ह.

Meaning: look; see, familiar imperative or verb stem

Meaning: came; masculine singular completed form of आना
Notes: Agrees here with a masculine singular subject.

Example Meaning: I want to live in this city.
Notes: Context distinguishes living somewhere from staying or remaining.

Notes: Often describes a general or recurring state.

Example: कक्षा नौ बजे शुरू होती है।

Example: आज मेरे पास बहुत काम है।

Example Meaning: I have a lot of work today.

Example Meaning: I know how to make tea.

Example Meaning: Drinking clean water every day is good.
Notes: A basic consumption verb.
Changes to अच्छी or अच्छे to agree with gender and number.

Changes to नई or नए to agree with gender and number.

Example Meaning: We should think about this matter.

Also appears in नाम का and नाम से expressions.
